a6.roof_floor.text: Cool tiles under bare feet. Bliss.

a6.railing.text: Now Bhai can fly his kite without giving me a heart attack.

a6.tank.text: It doesn't leak anymore. I am a genius.

a6.kite.text: It's flying! Didi, look, it's FLYING!

a6.lights.text: Fairy lights! It's like a little festival every night.

a6.clothesline.text: Sun-dried clothes smell the best. That's a fact.

a6.umbrella.text: Tea, shade and a view. I could stay here all day.

a6.chairs.text: Sit with me, nani. Watch the hills turn pink.

a6.pots.text: Fresh mint! My tea will be famous.

a6.arrive.text: The roof! The best place in the whole house!
It would be, if the railing wasn't held up by a broom.

a6.outro.text: My kite went higher than the neighbour's!
From up here the whole tole looks like family.
Speaking of the tole... the courtyard could use some love, Maya.
Then let's fix it for everyone.
